mapper.sql: SELECT b.*, CASE WHEN due_at IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS due_group, COALESCE(due_at, CAST('1970-01-01 00:00:00' AS DATETIME)) AS due_sort, CASE WHEN due_at IS NULL THEN COALESCE(created_at, CAST('1970-01-01 00:00:00' AS DATETIME)) ELSE CAST('1970-01-01 00:00:00' AS DATETIME) END AS created_sort FROM () b

where.if: AND CAST(r.task_type AS BINARY) = CAST(#{q.taskType} AS BINARY)

if.test: q.filterField != null and q.filterValue != null and q.filterValue != ''

where.if: AND CAST(COALESCE(r.source, '') AS BINARY) = CAST(#{q.filterValue} AS BINARY)LOCATE(CAST(#{q.filterValue} AS BINARY), CAST(COALESCE(r.source, '') AS BINARY)) > 0CAST(COALESCE(r.detail, '') AS BINARY) = CAST(#{q.filterValue} AS BINARY)LOCATE(CAST(#{q.filterValue} AS BINARY), CAST(COALESCE(r.detail, '') AS BINARY)) > 0CAST(COALESCE(r.status_label, '') AS BINARY) = CAST(#{q.filterValue} AS BINARY)LOCATE(CAST(#{q.filterValue} AS BINARY), CAST(COALESCE(r.status_label, '') AS BINARY)) > 01 = 0

AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM system_profile_workbench_task_visibility v WHERE v.tenant_id = #{q.tenantId} AND v.user_id = #{q.userId} AND v.deleted = 0 AND CAST(v.task_key AS BINARY) = CAST(r.task_key AS BINARY))

mapper.sql: ORDER BY CAST(COALESCE(r.task_type, '') AS BINARY)CAST(COALESCE(r.source, '') AS BINARY)CAST(COALESCE(r.detail, '') AS BINARY)CAST(COALESCE(r.status_label, '') AS BINARY)CAST('' AS BINARY) DESCASC, r.due_group ASC, r.due_sort ASC, r.created_sort DESC, r.numeric_id DESC
